subject: english
title: Introducing yourself
text: “My name is Haru.” “I’m from Hoshikawa.” “Nice to meet you.” São as três frases de qualquer apresentação.

subject: english
title: Verb to be
text: I am · you are · he/she/it is · we/they are. Contrações: I’m, you’re, she’s, we’re, they’re.

subject: english
title: Wh- questions
text: What (o quê), Where (onde), How (como), Who (quem). “Where are you from?” “How old are you?”

subject: english
title: Greetings
text: Good morning (manhã), good afternoon (tarde), good evening (ao chegar à noite), good night (ao se despedir à noite).

subject: english
title: Days and routine
text: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. “I go to school at eight.”

subject: english
title: Numbers and age
text: Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen… “I’m fifteen years old.” Twenty é 20; twelve é 12.

subject: english
title: Family
text: Mother, father, grandmother (avó), grandfather, brother, sister. “I live with my grandmother.”

subject: english
title: Likes and hobbies
text: “I like drawing.” “I don’t like running.” Hobbies: drawing, running, reading, cooking, playing basketball.

subject: english
title: Go → went
text: Alguns verbos não seguem a regra do -ed no passado: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate. Hill chama de “os rebeldes”.
